The Validation-SSF repository brings together simulations, empirical analyses and sensitivity analyses for generative validation of step-selection functions.

Study of extra hidden states under emission misspecification, with a genomic application and supplementary elk movement analyses.

### Dataset repositories to explore

These resources are linked to Données bleues. Each repository documents its sources, preparation and teaching scope.

- [Arbres du Québec](https://github.com/AurelienNicosiaULaval/arbres_quebec): tree measurements for exploration, species comparisons and modelling.
- [Véhicules](https://github.com/AurelienNicosiaULaval/vehicules-quebec): Canadian vehicle data and a separate overview of the Quebec vehicle fleet.
- [Empress of Ireland](https://github.com/AurelienNicosiaULaval/empress-of-ireland-data): aggregated historical tables for studying counts, proportions and interpretation limits.

## Using the resources

Installation instructions, examples and software versions are collected in [R packages](packages.qmd). [Courses and teaching materials](enseignement.qmd) and [educational innovation projects](innovation.qmd) provide complementary resources.

To reproduce an analysis or reuse materials, consult the instructions, data sources and licence in the relevant repository.
